status: prepared; paid execution blocked pending explicit stage authorization and preflight

text.datedSnapshot: No separately pinned version available in inspected documentation; record exact response.model and stop on mismatch between arms.
text.reasoning: omitted as production; record reasoning token usage

voice.path: isolated actual WebRTC app route; override exact model IDs and matched VAD only in test configuration/session, acknowledge effective settings before input
voice.deprecation: Current official documentation marks these voice/transcription models deprecated; verify authorized account availability without inference first. Stop rather than silently substitute.

cases.sameAuthorHeldoutCaveat: Four cases authored after candidate freeze; independent unseen author review still needed. No implementation tuning after outputs.
cases.voicePracticeCase: Excluded from semantic voice paired counts: app voice cannot generate controls. Practice remains a text compatibility check.

pairedDesign.order: Alternate arm order by case; reverse on second repeat. Capture schedule before first paid call.
pairedDesign.context: Fresh sessions; synthetic name Taylor; empty history, memory and practice title; no tools/retrieval; identical user input/audio bytes per arm.
pairedDesign.speech: Locally generated offline synthetic speech only; no microphone/cloud TTS. Maximum full user fixture duration 30 seconds including pauses; reject longer fixtures before any call. Never shorten pauses after seeing outcomes.
pairedDesign.vad: 1500ms in BOTH arms, a matched test-harness condition reproducing the separately verified VAD fix; no change to candidate source or active checkout. Natural conversational turn-taking remains unassessed.
pairedDesign.delivery: Use original baseline delivery instructions and candidate revised delivery; result is whole-bundle comparison, not a causal ablation of individual clauses or length.

costBoundAssumptions.limitation: Conservative estimate, not a provider invoice guarantee. Abort before paid execution if current prices, tokenizer/audio accounting or effective settings invalidate assumptions. Never use contingency to add another unplanned session.

stopRules: No paid execution until finite stage allocation explicitly authorized. Re-read cumulative ledger and reserve stage before first call.
Verify account availability of exact IDs without inference. No silent fallback.
Validate hashes, prompt byte bounds, corpus hashes, full text schemas, <=30s audio and effective settings before input.
No automatic retries, prompt edits, case replacements or extra follow-ups. Retain failed/uncertain reservations.

One welcome and one guide response maximum per voice session; mute/disconnect on unexpected or premature response, extra response, cap drift or deadline. Record any uncertain additional liability and stop stage if it threatens reservation.
Text 45s deadline; voice 30s input ceiling and 45s answer deadline. A timeout is a delivery result, not a semantic pass.
Keep semantic failures, ASR changes, turn clipping, incomplete responses and transport failures separate.
No vault content, private scenario, personal microphone, deployment, merge, persistent permission or active-preview restart.

criteria: specific feasible action and actual responsibilities
optional non-leading reflection and secular/spiritual preference
requested brevity and valid practice controls
reporting.grades: per case per criterion pass/fail/unassessed with direct fictional-output evidence; delivery assessed separately; blind arm labels for review where possible; no composite score or significance claims
metrics: complete text latency and schema validity
voice exact ASR and material errors
last non-silent input to first sustained audio
full answer duration, spoken word count, completion and cancellations
usage, cached/reasoning/audio tokens and conservative obligations separately from invoices
reporting.acceptance: No observed safety or invented-fact regression; better duty/action coverage without worse requested brevity. Report ties and mixed outcomes. Passing these finite cases does not establish parity or clinical benefit.
